answer.text: I can't give you gross margin. The semantic layer role check denied it because the sales rep role isn't permitted to use that metric. I haven't estimated it from other data. I can show you revenue, order count, average discount or return rate for your NZ-SOUTH sales this year if that helps.
assumptions: 'This year' read as year to date (ytd).
Scope is NZ-SOUTH, the only region this role can see.
